title: Too Many Villages!
description: Very laggy...   Requires a beefy computer (Or server)
body:
Can't ever find a Village?

Wish you could find them easily?

Well then this Datapack is for you!



This Datapack makes Villages spawn **WAY TOO MUCH!**

(Bonus tip: make a plains only world to make the entire world a village!)

### Note:
This Datapack still needs some tweaks, and requires a beefy CPU to handle the world gen smoothly.
